question: How do you usually get things together for the walking group?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “I wash the bibs, then lay things out in the evening when the kitchen’s quiet. Sometimes my housemate reads the jobs back to me while I gather everything. The bus card lives in the bib bag’s pocket now—that was my little improvement after last week! The bibs were clean and ready; it was nearly taking them without me that was the problem. Well, me without them!”
